title: This powerhouse M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 48GB of RAM is $400 off
content:
Macworld

MacBook Pro M5 Pro

View Deal

If you’re looking for a new laptop for back-to-school or just want to upgrade an old model, you can grab one of Apple’s best MacBook Pro configurations for a whopping $400 off at B&H right now. The specs are impressive—an M5 Pro processor, 48GB of RAM, and 1TB of storage for just $2,899, an excellent price to pay if you’re looking for a machine that will last for years to come.

Running on the M5 Pro chip with its 18-core CPU and 20-Core GPU, this laptop is an absolute powerhouse. Every one of those GPU cores packs a Neural Accelerator, so if your work is AI-heavy, this MacBook is more than ready to handle it all. Pair that with 48GB of unified memory, and this laptop breezes through demanding workloads without breaking a sweat.

Whether you want to edit 4K footage, juggle massive image libraries, compile large codebases, or mix hundreds of audio tracks at once, this MacBook Pro can do it all. And with all-day battery life and a super-fast 1TB SSD, you’ll be able to work on giant files and videos wherever you are. And if you need more, you can attach a Thunderbolt 5 drive that’ll feel just as fast.

Of course, the 14.2-inch Liquid Retina XDR display is one you’ll love looking at for long hours. With 1,600 nits of peak brightness, a billion colors, and super-accurate shades, there’s nothing not to love about this display, no matter how bright the room is.

So whether you’re a pro or a student, this laptop is a powerful machine at a fantastic price. At $2,899, a full $400 off, the M5 Pro MacBook Pro delivers serious power, a stunning display, and all-day battery life in a portable package built to last.
